chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him), in which he points to the oppression of the Banu Umayya.

key_terms.بَنِي أُمِيَّةَ: Banu Umayya, the Umayyad clan, a prominent Qurayshi family that ruled the Islamic Caliphate.
key_terms.ظُلْمِ: Oppression or injustice, referring to the political and social wrongs committed by the Umayyads.
key_terms.كَلَامِهِ: His sayings or speeches, referring to the words of Imam Ali (peace be upon him).

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the oppression of the Umayyads?
ai.summary: This narration from Nahj al-Balagha highlights Imam Ali’s critique of the Umayyads' usurpation of authority, framing their rule not merely as political mismanagement but as a deviation from divine justice. It serves as a foundational text in Shia historiography for understanding the transition from the Rashidun caliphate to the hereditary monarchy of the Umayyads.
